picks.title: Hacker awarded $50k bounty for reporting bug to Sony that allowed PS5 Linux exploit — move sparks backlash from jailbreaking community
picks.summary: The hypervisor bug that allowed PS5 users to install Linux on their consoles was patched before the launch of GTA VI, meaning they have to choose between experimenting with Linux and running the game.

picks.title: CISA confirms PHP2Shell vulnerabilities now exploited in attacks
picks.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday. [...]

Energy giant ENGIE discloses data breach affecting customers
picks.summary: French energy giant ENGIE, one of the world s largest power and natural gas providers, confirmed that attackers stole customer data after breaching a marketing platform used by business partners. [...]

picks.title: Ripple gains final OCC approval to launch national trust bank and bring RLUSD under federal oversight
picks.summary: Ripple s structure places reserve management and custody under federal supervision while leaving issuance with the New York-regulated entity.

picks.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Its Half-Good AI Model at Half the Price
picks.summary: OpenAI s mid-tier model now operates apps and screens more like a person would, with API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra and an error rate that OpenAI says fell sharply.

picks.summary: Nvidia is committing billions to expand substrate, co-packaged optics, advanced packaging, and chip-testing capacity through 2028, reserving capacity at nearly every stage of its AI accelerator supply chain.

picks.title: Ripple Wins Final OCC Trust Bank Approval for RLUSD Reserves and Custody
picks.summary: RLUSD will retain its New York-regulated issuer while the national trust bank manages reserves and provides fiduciary digital asset custody.

picks.title: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
picks.summary: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.
